messages:
aisha_csm: Heads up — MonarchHealth renewal is getting tight. They asked to shorten the term to 9 months and switch to a PO with a vendor code. Procurement says they won't sign without vendor code and a PO net30. CFO (signer) is traveling until next Tue, so DocuSign flow is delayed. :warning: We need a plan to avoid losing seats.

mike_sales: Ugh. Do we have vendor code on file? can we accept CC as fallback if procurement can't get PO in time?

aisha_csm: No vendor code yet. They mentioned they need our vendor code + the SOW updated to reflect 9mo term. CC fallback probably not an option for legal/compliance there.

jess_onboard: Onboarding status: SAML + data connector done, pilot dashboards at 3/4. We were planning enablement week of 5/6 (2 sessions). If contract slips past 5/2 we lose provisioning slot and that'll delay GA onboarding.

luis_revops: I can add vendor code but need PO number + billing entity. If they can send PO draft to billing@redwood.com I can pre-create the vendor entry. Can someone ask procurement contact for PO ETA?

aisha_csm: @mike_sales can you ping procurement contact (Mark) and ask for a PO draft? I'll offer to get vendor code pre-provisioned if they email billing. Also asking legal about 9mo amendment.

mike_sales: pinged Mark via email. copied procurement thread: https://docsend.com/s/monarch-po-draft (link)

dina_legal: 9mo term = amendment to current SOW. We can prepare an addendum with the shortened term and sign via DocuSign. But legal needs confirmation on billing entity and signatory authority. If CFO is sign-limited, we can route to delegated signer.

aisha_csm: Noted. Action items: 1) Mike follow up on PO draft today. 2) Luis pre-create vendor code once PO draft arrives. 3) Dina will draft 9mo SOW addendum and mark delegated signer option. 4) Jess hold two enablement slots tentatively for week of 5/6.

jess_onboard: Tentatively blocked — will hold 5/6 and 5/8 10–11am PT. If contract pushed, we'll need to reschedule.

mike_sales: Mark says PO draft by EOD. He flagged finance needs vendor W-9 and tax info. Do we have updated W-9?

luis_revops: W-9 is in shared drive: /billing/vendor_forms/Redwood_W9_2025.pdf. I'll attach to the email once Mark confirms.

aisha_csm: Great. One more risk: customer asked about KMS/HSM for key control on Private deployment — that's a blocker for them going to prod. Recorded as product feedback. @dina_legal any compliance notes we should surface?

dina_legal: Not a legal blocker for signature, but enable security team loop. We'll flag as a potential sales qualification for Private. Capture in CS feedback doc.

docsend-bot: Document opened by mark@monarchhealth.com — 3 pages, 2:12pm PST

aisha_csm: Timeline ask: if PO arrives today and addendum is signed by delegated signer by 5/2 we keep enablement. If not, propose a one-week bridge credit to hold seats while procurement finishes — @mike_sales do we have authority to offer credit?

mike_sales: Can offer up to 10% one-time credit with RevOps approval. @luis_revops pls confirm.

luis_revops: Confirmed — we can approve up to 10% one-time. I'll need the PO and a short justification note from CSM.

aisha_csm: I'll draft the justification and send to @luis_revops. Thanks all — I'll update thread when PO arrives. :thumbsup:

(END)
